watch.summary: After making a mistake in Rocket League, the creator resets his composure before setting up an aerial hit and dramatically shouting at his teammates to score it.

beats.what: The creator calms himself down after a miss, whispering 'Relax, relax, my bad.'
He resets with solemn focus, asking 'Shall we begin?' as he drives up the field.
He executes a clean aerial pass off the side wall.
He explodes with theatrical outrage, shouting for someone to finish the job.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Somebody be there to finish the job! I have already done... what more do you want from me?!
watch.why: The sharp contrast between his calm, self-soothing composure at the start and his sudden dramatic outburst creates a fun comedic shift. His intense facial expressions and theatrical commentary elevate a routine gameplay situation.
